summary: Guided avatar and graphics comparison for a crowded VRChat instance. This does not measure frame rate and does not change Process Lasso.
notes: Compare one change at a time: quiet world, crowded world, avatar policy, or cleanup.
Use the VRChat configuration window for avatar rank, max shown avatars, hide-beyond distance, graphics profile, MSAA, and mirrors.
Performance effect stays not measured until a real import exists.
